viewing_check: Ask staff to power it on: check it reaches the Setup Assistant 'Select your country' screen with no Activation Lock or Remote Management screen. Apple menu > About This Mac for chip, memory and storage. Read the serial on the underside and the box label (A2348 = M1; A2686 = M2). Check for dents and port damage.
